post.description: To verify a New Jersey license number: status, dates, status change reason and whether a public board action is on file.

facility.description:
Which register to search; omit to try person then business.

Provider reference: allowed values ["person", "business"].

license_number.description: The full license number as the site prints it, e.g. 26NO09001800 (nursing), D07351800 (CDS), 25MZ00081700 (acupuncture). Case-insensitive.

200.description:
The License Information record of one New Jersey license (Details.aspx): licensee name, city and state of record (business records also the street address), profession and license type, license number, license status, status change reason (e.g. Board Order), last status change date, issue and expiration dates, the Board Action YES/NO flag with the site's explanation, the board's discipline-information note, CDS drug schedules and DEA number when the record is a CDS registration, and prerequisite / related licenses. Found by searching the license number on the person form, then the business form when `facility` is not given, and opening the matching row in the same server session. An unknown license number is `not_found`. The site does not publish disciplinary action dates or documents (it points to the Board / DCA website).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | object |  |
| `board_action` | string | The site's Board Action flag: YES means a public record of some board action (consent order, reprimand, final order, pending complaint ...) is on file; NO none; null when the record has no Board Action panel. |
| `board_action_note` | string | The site's explanation under the Board Action flag. |
| `dea_number` | string | CDS registrations only, when printed. |
| `discipline_info` | string | The board's note on where to obtain discipline information (e.g. pre-2010 discipline by e-mail). |
| `drug_schedules` | object | CDS registrations only: Yes/No per controlled dangerous substance schedule as printed; null for other licenses. |
| `expiration_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `facility` | string |  |
| `full_name` | string |  |
| `home_state` | string | The record's SPL / home state field (multistate nursing licenses), when printed. |
| `issue_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `last_status_change_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD when printed (business records show this field; person records do not). |
| `license_number` | string |  |
| `license_status` | string | Active, Expired, Revoked, Suspended, Inactive, Retired, ... as the site prints it. |
| `license_type` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `prerequisites` | object[] | Prerequisite / related licenses listed on the record (e.g. the pharmacy license behind a CDS registration); empty when the panel is blank. |
| `profession` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | The search form the record was found through; the site's Details.aspx key is per-session and not linkable. |
| `status_change_reason` | string | e.g. `Board Order`; null when the site leaves it blank. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.board_action_note:
Please visit DCA's website to see the final disposition documents.
* A "YES" in the "Board Action" field indicates that the licensee has a public record of some form of action on file with the Board/Committee. Board actions may come in the form of a Consent Order, Cease and Desist Order, Interim Order, Reprimand, a finalized Uniform Penalty Letter, agreed upon Settlement Letter or Final Order. In some instances, "Yes" will represent that a public record of a pending matter such as an Administrative Complaint or a Provisional Order of Discipline may have been filed with the Board/Committee. Such documents represent the filing of allegations by the Attorney General, and do not represent a finding of misconduct until the matter is adjudicated by the Board. Contact the Board/Committee directly to obtain a copy of such documents.
value.discipline_info: For discipline information prior to January 01, 2010 please contact the Board of Nursing via bondiscipline@dca.njoag.gov.

200.description:
The option lists of the New Jersey license verification search form (Search.aspx?facility=N or Y): every profession (board) name and every license-type name the form accepts as filter values, exactly as the site spells them. With `profession` set, the function performs the form's profession postback and returns only that profession's license types. Use the returned strings verbatim as `profession` / `license_type` in search_licenses.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `license_types` as the primary payload key.

The provider does not publish a field list for this tool.

200.description:
Licensee search of the New Jersey verification site (Search.aspx -> SearchResults.aspx): one 40-row page of licensees matching any combination of profession, license type, first/middle name, last name (person) or business name (business), license number and city. Text criteria match the site's way (prefix / partial, case-insensitive, at least 2 characters). Rows carry full name, license number, profession, license type, license status, city and state. The site keeps results in its server session, so each page request replays form GET, search POST and results GET, then steps the grid pager to the requested page; a `continuation` is returned while the pager offers a next page. A search that matches nothing is a successful empty page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `city` | string |  |
| `full_name` | string |  |
| `license_number` | string | Blank (null) on the site for some Deleted records. |
| `license_status` | string | Active, Expired, Revoked, Suspended, Inactive, ... as the site prints it. |
| `license_type` | string |  |
| `profession` | string |  |
| `state` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
